title: Quadratic equations: practice set 2
sourceNote: Original practice questions written for this group. None of them is a CAT previous-year question.
instructions: 10 questions, 20 minutes, CAT marking: +3 right, -1 wrong multiple choice, 0 for a wrong type-in answer.
Type-in answers take a number only: no %, ₹ or units. Use a decimal, not a fraction.

questions.text: What are the roots of x² + x − 20 = 0?
What is the sum of the roots of 3x² − 12x + 7 = 0?
For what positive value of k does 4x² + kx + 9 = 0 have two equal roots?
A ball is thrown straight up. Its height after t seconds is h = 20t − 5t² metres. What is the greatest height it reaches?
If α and β are the roots of x² − 7x + 2 = 0, find α³ + β³.
The roots of x² − 7x + 10 = 0 are α and β. Which equation has the roots α + 1 and β + 1?
A group of friends share a ₹1,200 bill equally. If 2 more friends had joined, each person would have paid ₹50 less. How many friends are in the group?
The equation x² + (k − 3)x + k = 0 has real roots. Which of these gives every possible value of k?
If α and β are the roots of x² − 4x + 1 = 0, find α⁴ + β⁴.
A shop sells 200 kurtas a month at ₹600 each. For every ₹20 it cuts the price, it sells 10 more kurtas a month. What price gives the largest monthly revenue?
